args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. All were reported with the width-free ratio, so the plane-sections check was not run. Rigid-body invariance and closure passed in every run.
Flagged (2), summary_outlier: r01 and r06. Their largest flank difference is at 284 µm, not 1074 µm as in the other runs. That means the curvature-rate profile has a different shape. Their growth zone is also slightly shorter (684 vs 695 µm), and their REGR peak is slightly lower (52.96 vs 53.1 %/h).
Cleared (6): r02, r03, r04, r05, r07, r08. Their REGR peak (about 53.1 %/h at 421 µm), growth-zone length and flank-difference profile all match the batch. In r04, r05 and r08 the width-free ratio has z 4.18 only because the batch MAD is small. Their ratio is 0.074 against a median of -0.019, and it peaks at the same 50 µm as the rest of the batch.
What the flagged runs share: r01 and r06 have identical final measurements. Both took 6 steps with no roll backs and kept the same width-free remedy. They differ from the batch in where the flank difference peaks, not in REGR level.
Note: the summaries repeat in identical groups (r01/r06, r02/r03/r07, r04/r05/r08). Check that these are separate roots or time windows and not the same movie entered more than once.
